question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose bounded reset-family transcript history through `includeFamily`, with requests combining `includeFamily` and `offset` rejected?
rationale: This additive Gateway and model-tool capability changes public transcript visibility and pagination semantics; tests establish mechanics but cannot choose the permanent API boundary.

options.title: Accept bounded family history
options.body: Keep `includeFamily` as the single opt-in selector and retain explicit offset incompatibility after conflict resolution.

options.title: Unify archive history APIs
options.body: Pause this PR and define one coordinated contract with broader archived-transcript proposals before landing an implementation.

options.title: Keep active-only history
options.body: Reject the new selector and leave historical recovery to explicit archive-browsing or UI surfaces.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded family history
recommendation.body: Keep `includeFamily` as the single opt-in selector and retain explicit offset incompatibility after conflict resolution.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest evidence-backed connection to the underlying agent/session runtime and is the best available route for the API decision.
